prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE new standalone square close portrait for HUMAN Zou Run (邹润), nickname 独角龙, for a Water Margin RTS character encyclopedia/HUD. Not a grid.
Input1 is old 3x3 portrait atlas: identity reference ONLY for BOTTOM RIGHT character, source rectangle x777 y800 width423 height400 of the 1200x1200 image. Ignore other eight characters. Input2 is current Zou Run walking-strip body for red-brown cloth forehead band, topknot, red work-warrior coat and restrained bronze/brown lamellar shoulders. DO NOT copy its forehead pointed horn: the novel places the named feature at the BACK of the head, not on the forehead. Do not copy its weapon.
Canon from Chapter49: mature human Zou Run, nephew of Zou Yuan but about the same age, 身材长大，天生一等异相，脑后一个肉瘤，以此人都唤他做“独角龙”。 Depict a HUMAN with ONE rounded flesh-colored prominence on the OCCIPUT/back of the head, behind the ear and below the crown/bun. It is a natural rounded flesh contour, with normal intact skin and surrounding hair, not a horn, forehead bump, dragon anatomy, injury, infection or wound. Do not turn the nickname into a dragon or magical power. Exact size, face, hairstyle, uniform and colors are game art design.
Composition is essential: a close SIDE/three-quarter profile facing screen-right so the viewer clearly sees his nose, one eye, cheek, ear, AND the posterior skull outline behind the ear on screen-left. Show the single modest rounded flesh prominence at the back of his skull directly below/behind the bun, anatomically separate from a hair bun or cloth knot. Keep forehead NORMAL and unhorned. A simple red-brown forehead band may cross the front and tie high, leaving the back feature visible. No helmet concealing it. Entire head, rear contour and bun fit with safe margins. Face and head dominate the square, shoulders extend at bottom.
Human identity: mature adult, tall/broad-shouldered impression, stern composed eyes, natural warm tan skin, dark mustache and short goatee consistent with his named old portrait, dark hair/topknot, red-brown collar and simple bronze/brown lamellar shoulder edge. He is not a teenager despite the nephew relationship. No weapon or hand. No roar or aggressive new story action.
Style: restrained historical Chinese ink-and-opaque-paint portrait, dark controlled silhouette, subtle texture, warm full-frame parchment backdrop and soft even light, matching the game's standalone portrait family. Prioritize the unhorned human face and correct back-of-head rounded contour; do not exaggerate into a grotesque medical illustration. No labels, arrows, inset diagram, text, frame, watermark, horns, scales, dragon/tiger ears, masks, glowing eyes, magic, blood or gore.
